values.summary: Implemented an independent portable adl-engine crate that consumes the landed inert adl-compiler ExecutionPlan and provides a deterministic, transactional, explicitly bounded state machine with typed provider/tool effects and strict quiescent resume.
actual_changes: Added canonical node readiness, bounded ready/in-flight dispatch, all/at-least/fail-fast joins, and stable dependency failure propagation
Added monotonic attempt accounting, explicit logical-tick retry schedules, stable failure classes, saturation reporting, deterministic cancellation, and idempotent completion replay
Added separate typed provider, governed-tool, and cancellation request/completion contracts with SHA-256 request and idempotency identities
Added canonical plan/policy/limit-bound snapshots, quiescent-only checkpoints, canonical encoding enforcement, strict counter/state compatibility checks, and uninterrupted-versus-resumed equivalence
Added complete boundary, negative, permutation, port, cancellation, retry, join, checkpoint, and fresh-process proof under FastWork
Kept product source free of I/O, networking, clocks, processes, threads, async runtimes, Runtime v2/v3, adapters, C-SDLC, unsafe code, and source-authority parser expansion

actual_validation.purpose: Prove the bounded engine's focused functional, boundary, failure, join, cancellation, retry, compiler-edge, port, checkpoint, resume, and fresh-process contracts.
Prove formatting, all-target compilation and tests, strict linting, source-authority boundaries, and the exact direct COTS dependency graph.
Prove byte-identical fresh-process transcripts, canonical quiescent checkpoint round trips, completion-order invariance, and uninterrupted-versus-resumed equivalence.
Prove the engine stays within 4,000 implementation LoC and 3,500 test/fixture LoC, preserves exact COTS pins and sole-writer scope, and completes under the declared bounded validation budgets.
